articles.title: Anthropic Releases Claude 4 with Extended Reasoning and 2M Token Context Window
articles.summary: Anthropic has officially launched Claude 4, featuring a breakthrough 2 million token context window and enhanced extended thinking capabilities that allow the model to work through complex multi-step problems. The new model reportedly outperforms competitors on coding, mathematics, and scientific reasoning benchmarks. Enterprise customers gain access starting today, with consumer availability rolling out over the next two weeks.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's AlphaFold 4 Predicts RNA and DNA Structures with Near-Perfect Accuracy
articles.summary: Google DeepMind announced AlphaFold 4, expanding beyond protein folding to predict the 3D structures of RNA, DNA, and small molecules with unprecedented accuracy. Researchers say the tool could dramatically accelerate drug discovery for diseases including cancer and Alzheimer's. The model is being made available to academic researchers through a new API portal launching this week.

articles.title: OpenAI Launches Operator Enterprise: Autonomous AI Agents for Business Workflows
articles.summary: OpenAI has unveiled Operator Enterprise, a platform allowing businesses to deploy autonomous AI agents capable of managing end-to-end workflows including procurement, customer service, and software deployment. The system integrates with over 500 enterprise tools including Salesforce, SAP, and Jira out of the box. Early adopters like JPMorgan and Siemens report up to 40% reduction in operational costs during the beta period.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Body Issues First Major Fines to Three Tech Firms
articles.summary: The newly operational EU AI Enforcement Office handed down its first significant penalties, fining three unnamed technology companies a combined €340 million for deploying high-risk AI systems without proper conformity assessments. The fines signal a new era of regulatory teeth in the European AI landscape. Legal experts say more enforcement actions are expected in Q3 2026 as regulators work through a backlog of complaints.

articles.title: Meta Releases Llama 4 Scout Open-Source Multimodal Model with Video Understanding
articles.summary: Meta has open-sourced Llama 4 Scout, a multimodal model capable of understanding and reasoning across text, images, audio, and full video sequences up to 30 minutes long. The model is available under a permissive commercial license on Hugging Face and Meta's own platform. Developers are already reporting strong performance on video question answering and real-time scene description tasks.

articles.title: Microsoft Integrates RAG-Powered Copilot Deeply into Windows 12, Raising Privacy Concerns
articles.summary: Microsoft has begun rolling out a deeply embedded Copilot experience in Windows 12 that uses on-device retrieval-augmented generation to index and query a user's full file system, emails, and browsing history. The feature, called Copilot Recall Pro, has immediately sparked debate among privacy advocates who argue the local indexing creates significant security vulnerabilities. Microsoft says all data remains on-device and encrypted, but has paused the rollout in the EU pending regulatory review.

articles.title: Stanford HAI Report Warns of Accelerating AI Energy Consumption Crisis
articles.summary: Stanford University's Human-Centered AI Institute released its annual AI Index report, highlighting that global AI data center energy consumption grew 210% year-over-year and is projected to exceed the energy usage of France by 2028. The report calls for mandatory energy disclosure requirements for frontier AI model training runs. Several leading AI labs have responded by announcing new efficiency research initiatives.

articles.title: Hugging Face Launches SmolAgents 2.0 with Visual Tool-Use and Code Sandboxing
articles.summary: Hugging Face has released SmolAgents 2.0, a major update to its lightweight agent framework that adds native visual tool-use, allowing agents to interact with GUIs and web browsers through screenshot-based perception. The update also includes a secure code sandboxing environment that runs agent-generated code in isolated containers, addressing a key safety concern for production deployments. The framework now supports plug-and-play integration with any Hugging Face hosted model.
